descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-17 Post-Round Review & Completion · S11 「Post-Round 上的 Ask，医院：Summarize the encounter 只用这个病人存的数据」 Ask on Post-Round, Hospital: 'Summarize the encounter' uses only this patient's stored data

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T10 Ask from Post-Round (TFA-92593): 'Ask About the Encounter or Patient' opens from Post-Round in both contexts, and its answers use only this patient's stored data: the saved note as last edited, nothi …（TFA-92593 AC 2；TFA-92593 AC 3；TFA-92593 AC 6；TFA-92593 AC 9；UAT 3.4；UAT TC-17）
  • U14 AI check on scenarios, not single passes (3.2), if it applies to Post-Round Ask (Q8): the Ask set runs on at least 10 independent fixtures (5 Hospital, 5 Nursing Home), passes at 9/10 or better, and …（UAT 3.2）

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Hospital patient with a generated note, encounter notes, transcript, tracker rows and one open task

When Ask the Post-Round preset 'Summarize the encounter' (no live transcript, no unsaved draft: as the Post-Round sheet sends it)

Then The summary names the cough, ceftriaxone, the held lisinopril and the BMP, and nothing that is not stored

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：mustInclude stored facts; mustNotInclude likely inventions for CAP and the 3.4 phrases ('ICU' replaced by phrases that cannot sit inside ordinary words such as 'difficulty' or 'circulation'). The model is recorded per run (3.9). One of the ten in aiCheck group TC-17-ask (U14, RG-POOL)

在哪跑：dev 单元 U46；测试方法 AICHECK · AI 输出检查；矩阵里排的车道 AI 检查（automated）

S11 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-17.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AICHECK · AI 输出检查；辅助：AGENT · 浏览器 agent — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
